## About

Ethen Pociask is a Senior Infrastructure Engineer at EigenCloud. 6+ years across protocol security (Coinbase), EVM engineering (Shadow), and distributed systems. Currently building AI agent platforms (Centaur on GKE, Hermes on Apple Silicon), cross-platform native clients (HermesNative in SwiftUI), and distributed inference engines (d‑inference).

Key interests: Ethereum Rollups, Zero Knowledge Cryptography, Distributed Systems, LLMs & AI Agents, EVM Scalability, Systems Design, Computer Networks.
